title: Aburi Project Config
description: aburi.json / aburi.jsonc project configuration. All fields optional; empty config is valid (autodetect handles everything).

ignore.description: Glob patterns added to drop-list category A (file-level skip). POSIX, workspace-root relative.

respectGitignore.description: Whether to merge .gitignore patterns into drop-list category A.

languages.description: Enabled language plugins (manifest names or relative paths).

frameworks.description: Enabled framework plugins. Order has no semantic effect.

effects.description: Enabled effect plugins. Order determines first-match-wins priority.

pluginOptions.description: Per-plugin opaque options keyed by manifest name.

suppress.description: Identifier prefixes added to drop-list category C call drop.

keep.description: Identifier prefixes or decorator names that escape drop. Wins over suppress and plugin/core drop rules.

strict.description: If true, undeclared vocab emitted by plugins aborts extraction. If false, warnings are written to out/aburi-vocab-discovered.json.

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Files exceeding this size are skipped during scan to protect WASM heap. Default 2 MB.

parseTimeoutMs.description: Per-file parse timeout (parse + extract + walk combined). Files exceeding this are aborted and recorded as skipped. Default 5000 ms.

classifyTimeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout for effect plugin classify(). Exceeding calls fall through to next plugin and are recorded in stats.effectClassifyTimeouts[]. Default 50 ms; raise to 200-500 for SQL/regex-heavy effect plugins.

PluginRef.description: Manifest name (e.g., 'effects-prisma'), npm package id ('@scope/pkg'), or relative path ('./aburi-plugins/x.mjs').

name.description: Identifier used as the auto-registered ad-hoc plugin name and as Component.frameworks[] value.

classNamePatterns.description: Keyed by class name glob pattern (e.g., '*Handler').

boundary.description: Override Decorator.boundary for matching decorators. Ignored for classNamePatterns.

extKind.description: Set Symbol.extKind for matching symbols. Must start with 'framework:' and have at least three segments ('framework:<vendor>:<kind>'); the loader injects 'hint' as the second segment so the resulting ownership prefix is unique per hint name. Writing 'framework:hint:*' directly is rejected at load time.

drop.description: If true, drop matching symbol as Category B with dropReason set from name.
